referee_caveats_inferred: Beam sizes, mosaic vs single pointing and quoted gas masses are internally inconsistent, so key numbers are hard to trust
Outflow claim rests on residuals in a face-on galaxy with an axisymmetric model; no independent outflow test (e.g. cube-based line-wing fitting)
Inflow vs outflow is not distinguished, yet the abstract states an outflow
Gas mass depends strongly on a CO ratio of 5.0 (unusual for L' units) and a wide alpha_CO range; abstract range 1-5e8 conflicts with computed 0.22-0.90e8
No fit uncertainties or priors given for the 3D-BAROLO, DISCFIT or CIGALE results
Robust = 2.0 (natural weighting) with a quoted sub-0.03'' beam is hard to reconcile with the rest of the text

missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters beyond weighting and robust (cell, image size, niter, threshold, mask)
Calibrator and flux-scale information for both ALMA projects
CIGALE module and parameter grids and the Table 3 photometry references
Band 3 imaging recipe and the aperture for the continuum flux
Resolution of the contradictory beam sizes and mosaic/pointing statements
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: about 50-100 GB raw (Band 6 mosaic with 1920 channels plus a short Band 3 observation); calibrated cube a few GB
reproducibility.score_reason: Scale 1-5. Data are two named ALMA projects, but the imaging setup is only partly given, key numbers conflict (beam sizes, gas mass), and the modelling parameters for 3D-BAROLO, DISCFIT and CIGALE are not listed.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state that the data are public, the 3D-BAROLO, DISCFIT and CIGALE setups are incomplete, and several reported numbers are inconsistent, so the main results cannot be redone as written.
